messages:
alex: quick report from the q-onboard run for beluga-q6: we're getting ~6.7% of funcall/contracts where the array fields (tools/actions) arrive as a single-quoted or escaped string. breaks strict deserialization and triggers retries. sample below.
marta: can you paste a minimal sample? was this after the new KV packing change?
alex: yes, right after we enabled compact-kv and ran the q6 int8 sweep. repro curl: 
```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" -d '{\"model\":\"beluga-q6\",\"prompt\":\"call toolchain\",\"max_tokens\":60}'
```
bad response (truncated):
```
{"id":"x100","output":"{\\\"tools\\\": \\\"['search', 'extract']\\\", \\\"meta\\\": {\\\"score\\\": 0.92}}"}
```
chris: looks like the model is emitting a Python-list-like string inside the JSON. could be a tokenizer remap producing a leading quote token at the array start. do we have token dumps?
alex: attached a token stream extract to the canary job. notable pattern: when prefix > 48 tokens the first token for the array starts as a single-quote char in several traces. QA-bot: Canary 4432101234-beluga-q6-canary starting.
marta: short-term: do not auto-retry for endpoints that are marked \"side-effecting\". also add an SDK rescue that will try a conservative normalization only if the payload matches a small whitelist pattern. emit telemetry flag rescue_contract_normalized.
chris: agreed. also add a canary check that fails the onboarding if normalized-contract-rate > 0.3% on the sample set. we should be conservative on rollouts.
alex: plan for production: 1) deploy SDK rescue + telemetry, 2) block beluga-q6 from dedicated contract routes, route to beluga-fp16 baseline, 3) run golden-run diff (5k prompts) to compute contract pass delta, 4) attempt micro-head fine-tune or a tiny token-remap PTQ tweak.
marta: long-term I'd like a runtime pre-parser that can detect escaped/quoted-array patterns and either unescape or short-circuit to a safe fallback model before retries. but keep it opt-in.
chris: adding metrics: escaped_array_count, rescue_used_count, rescue_success_count. also sample 20 rescued payloads to the eval board for human triage.
ops-bot: Incident created: #INC-2188 linked to canary job 4432101234.
qa-bot: uploading canary artifacts: token-dumps, sample responses, and the golden-run baseline to the canary board.
marta: I'll kick the 5k golden-run comparing beluga-q6 to beluga-fp16 and post a delta report here when done. please avoid making broad routing changes until we see the diff.
alex: FYI reproduced at temps 0.0 and 0.6, streaming and non-streaming. looks like a decode-level artifact not pure sampling.
chris: tiny mitigation idea: add a decode post-filter that rejects leading single-quote tokens when generating a contract array and forces the next-token to be a left-bracket '[' token, but that's risky. prefer data-driven fixes.
marta: agreed. prioritize observability and conservative rollouts. if anyone sees similar patterns on other models, reply here so we can group investigations. :eyes:
